query: MATCH (d:Doc) WITH d, rank() OVER (ORDER BY text_bm25(d, 'body', 'magnetic field') DESC) AS lex_rank, rank() OVER (ORDER BY vector_score(d, 'body_emb', [0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) DESC) AS vec_rank RETURN d.title AS title, score_fuse(1.0 / (60 + lex_rank), 1.0 / (60 + vec_rank)) AS fused ORDER BY fused DESC, title ASC LIMIT 5
